data.title: Saudi, Bulgarian Ministers Discuss AI, Technology Partnership
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Communications and Information Technology Abdullah Alswaha met in Riyadh today with Bulgarian Minister of Innovation and Digital Transformation Ivan Vasilev to discuss prospects for partnership between the two countries in artificial intelligence, technology innovation, and capacity development, in support of digital economy growth.
    The meeting reviewed opportunities to strengthen cooperation in developing innovative solutions, exchanging expertise in building digital capabilities, supporting technology entrepreneurship, and expanding partnerships between companies in the two countries.
    -- SPA
13:52 Local Time 10:52 GMT
